selection_criteria.hypothesis: Hard max_price <= 0.40 filter eliminates 0.40-0.50 parity churn and produces sustainable edge.
selection_criteria.ml_edge_criterion: Model A1 with cap must outperform both Base A1 AND the Naive Price Rule (cap without ML) on Development.
selection_criteria.test_significance_criterion: Independent test expectancy lower 95% CI > 0 AND paired delta PnL lower CI > 0.
selection_criteria.inconclusive_rule: If test CI crosses zero, conclusion is strictly INCONCLUSIVE (do not claim edge).
